concerns.text: The plan states that no open‑source fatigue dataset with measured residual stress currently exists, so the entire scientific analysis (predictive‑gain comparison and mediation) will be performed on a deterministic synthetic dataset that is explicitly *not* used for scientific inference. This means the core research question—whether residual stress mediates the process‑fatigue relationship and adds predictive value—cannot be answered with any empirical evidence, violating causal/construct validity.

The proxy formula is changed from the spec’s linear form (σ_res ≈ k·heat_input·cooling_rate) to a non‑linear form (σ_res = k·log(heat_input+1)·sqrt(cooling_rate)) without any citation or justification. Because the proxy is derived from the same process parameters that constitute Feature Set A, it provides no independent information, undermining construct validity and the ability to attribute any predictive gain to “stress‑mediated” features.

Mediation analysis is conditioned on the presence of ≥ 50 rows with measured residual stress from a real dataset. Since no such dataset is available, the mediation step will be skipped, leaving the primary mediation claim untested. The plan offers no alternative strategy (e.g., data collection, simulation with realistic measurement error) to achieve sufficient power, so the study cannot meet FR‑013’s power requirement.
